name: Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
benefit: The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹600/-.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The applicant should be a person with disability.
   1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or more.
   1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 79 years.
   1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family.
   1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.
